'''Adrian''' is an NPC in [[The Black Shores]]. He can be found repairing a KU-Roro, [[KU-Boku]], at the [[Tethys Hub]] during the daytime (06:00 AM - 05:59 PM). 

At night (06.00 PM - 05.59 AM), he can be found talking with [[Leclerc]] in [[Haven of Sprouts]]

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(In Thetys Hub at afternoon)
:'''Adrian:''' Update failed? Why is this the only robot that's incompatible?
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong with this robot?
:'''Adrian:''' The components of its control system got an error. I'm repairing it and updating the system.
:'''KU-Boku:''' Ku... Ku... Feels bad... Ku...
:{{DIcon}} It looks uncomfortable.
:'''Adrian:''' It can't be. These robots don't feel pain. What you're hearing is just the language module reacting to the repairs.
:'''Adrian:''' Their personalities are also functions added by the Tethys System, something that needs regular maintenance.
:'''Adrian:''' Upgrading their systems and chips is the best way to improve them.
:'''Adrian:''' Trust me, I'm the best engineer here. This robot will be better than ever when I'm done.
----
;(In Haven of Sprouts at night)
:'''Leclerc:''' Adrian, are you planning to upgrade KU-Miki?
:'''Adrian:''' Yeah, its system's been acting up since the last update. I think the new component isn't compatible, so I need to make some adjustments.
:'''Leclerc:''' But you can't just change things like that. The last time you upgraded KU-Miki, it lost a whole year of memories!
:'''Adrian:'''That was a temporary side effect--things like discomfort, memory loss, or cognitive issues can happen sometimes. Once I'm done, everything will be fine.
:'''Leclerc:''' But you're interfering with its natural growth. It has its own way of adapting.
:'''Leclerc:''' We should guide these little ones based on their development, not just force changes on them.
:'''Adrian:'''It's more efficient if we handle the adjustments ourselves to improve their programming.
:'''Leclerc:''' Don't you think your approach is a bit too harsh? They hide from you every time they see you.
:'''Adrian:''' It's okay. I've got a remote controller to track them down.
:'''Leclerc:''' I... I just can't reason with you!
{{Dialogue End}}
